# Quantum Borrowed Ancilla Cost

This repository gives exact borrowed-qubit width versus full-channel accuracy for CCZ under excitation-conserving one- and two-qubit gates. Its authoritative scientific account is organized by topic under science/.

## Principal statement

There are three data qubits and m arbitrary borrowed qubits, N=m+3. The ideal operation is CCZ on the data and identity on all borrowed information. Error is half the diamond norm on the entire acted-on register, including arbitrary external references.

For every integer m>=0, the deterministic optimum is sin(pi/[4(m+2)]). The optimum over all input-independent classical mixtures, with the branch record discarded, is its square. With the classical record retained and scored against the same independent coin distribution, the optimum is the deterministic value. One prepared charge-eigenstate helper permits exact CCZ by established synthesis.

## Study route

The one educational anchor is John Watrous, The Theory of Quantum Information (2018). Section and statement numbers in the bridge refer to the author's pre-publication manuscript at https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/~watrous/TQI/. Use the relevant sections alongside the project's own explanations.

M01–M12 assemble the physical registers, charge sectors, quantum information, channel distance, classical randomization, imported reachability, and complete optimization model. M13–M21 develop the deterministic converse and attaining construction. M22–M27 connect the common probe and the exact two-branch calculation to the randomized law. M28–M30 integrate the scored-record boundary, charge-invariant witness, resource comparison, attribution, and limitations.

Watrous supplies the channel framework; the symmetry-specific results have their homes in science/ and the cited research papers. The completely bounded trace norm equals the diamond norm, while this project's error includes a factor of one half. Watrous uses unsquared fidelity; target-projector acceptance probabilities use its square.

## Interpretation rules

The target borrowed identity is approximated as part of the joint channel. Do not describe the positive-error construction as exact return of arbitrary borrowed states. The lower bound includes arbitrary correlations between data, borrowed qubits, and reference.

The native gate alphabet contains arbitrary continuous conserving gates, and finite circuit length is unrestricted. The imported independent special-unitary reachability theorem uses no additional helper. No efficient compiler or gate-count advantage is asserted for the general construction.

The deterministic locality obstruction, sector reachability, initialized helper mechanism, and generic coherent-error cancellation are established ingredients. The result developed here is their exact borrowed-width operational frontier, with an all-mixture converse. Consult the primary-source comparison before making novelty statements.

A fixed-charge promise on the acted-on register removes the obstruction. The full-channel witness can still have fixed total charge jointly with an untouched reference. Do not conflate these domains.

Finite computations verify identities and explicit examples. They do not prove universal optimality, establish literature priority, or certify efficient compilation.
